panels.title: Incidents traced
panels.description: Distinct Langfuse traces. One incident run produces one trace.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(trace_id) AS value FROM default.events_core WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)

panels.title: Spans
panels.description: Every observed step: workflow nodes, LLM calls and tool executions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS value FROM default.events_core WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
SELECT countIf(type = 'GENERATION') AS value FROM default.events_core WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)

panels.title: Tool executions
panels.description: Spans of type TOOL - the simulated estate being read or changed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(type = 'TOOL') AS value FROM default.events_core WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Spans recorded at ERROR level - failed tool calls and failed paths.

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(level = 'ERROR') AS value FROM default.events_core WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
SELECT toFloat64(sum(total_cost)) AS value FROM default.events_core WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)

panels.title: Span latency by type (p50 / p95)
panels.description: end_time is nullable while a span is open, so unfinished spans are excluded rather than counted as zero-duration.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, type, quantile(0.5)(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time)) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time)) AS p95 FROM default.events_core WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND end_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time, type ORDER BY time
SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, uniqExact(trace_id) AS incidents FROM default.events_core WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Token consumption
panels.description: usage_details is a map; input and output are summed separately so a prompt-size problem is distinguishable from a verbose-answer one.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time, sum(usage_details['input']) AS input_tokens, sum(usage_details['output']) AS output_tokens FROM default.events_core WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type = 'GENERATION' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT provided_model_name AS model, count() AS calls, sum(usage_details['total']) AS tokens, round(toFloat64(sum(total_cost)), 5) AS cost_usd, round(avg(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time))) AS avg_ms FROM default.events_core WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND type = 'GENERATION' AND provided_model_name != '' GROUP BY model ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Workflow steps by time spent
panels.description: Which stage of the incident workflow is actually slow.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS step, type, count() AS calls, round(avg(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time))) AS avg_ms, round(max(dateDiff('millisecond', start_time, end_time))) AS max_ms FROM default.events_core WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND end_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY step, type ORDER BY avg_ms DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Errors and failed paths
panels.description: Empty is the expected state. A failed investigation tool shows up here without the workflow having crashed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT start_time AS time, name, type, status_message, trace_id FROM default.events_core WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND level = 'ERROR' ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 50
